notablePrerequisites:
Rex does not have summoning sickness.
Sunastian Falconer and Pili-Pala exiled with a brain counter on them.
description:
Activate Rex using Sunastian Falconer's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Rex using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.
